configuration:
[profile.default]
src = "proofsrc"
test = "test"
out = "out"
libs = ["node_modules", "lib"]
solc_version = "0.8.38"
auto_detect_solc = false
via_ir = true
optimizer = true
optimizer_runs = 1000
evm_version = "osaka"
remappings = ["@openzeppelin/=node_modules/@openzeppelin/", "forge-std/=lib/forge-std/src/"]

[fuzz]
runs = 1000
seed = "0xdeadbeef"
scope: local production helpers and whale-ticket bootstrap parity
